item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 05/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will persist over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. It will be slightly cooler over the region. Meanwhile, a band of clouds will bring rainy weather to the region. With the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will become fine with daytime temperatures rising over southern China midweek next week.

Date/Month: 06/11 (Sunday)
Wind: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Cloudy with a few rain patches. Slightly cooler.
Temp range: 19 - 21 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
